bundle.shortDescription: Independent snapshots and safe recovery for Git worktrees
bundle.longDescription: Worktree Rescue is a local-first safety tool for AI-assisted development. It inventories Git worktrees, captures independent verified snapshots of uncommitted work, and recovers files into a separate directory without touching your repository.
